title: P17 Master Agent task record
description: Machine-verifiable contract for one P17 Master Agent task record: task identifiers, ordered plan, runtime agent discovery and deterministic selection with recorded rationale, controlled local execution, independent objective verification, governance-aligned status, timestamps, and integrity digests. SCOPE OF THIS SCHEMA - JSON Schema can enforce STRUCTURE and APPLICABLE FIELD CONSTRAINTS ONLY: which properties are present, enumerated values, string patterns, types, array constraints, and lifecycle-state coherence. It CANNOT and DOES NOT establish: that a runtime probe actually ran or that an agent is genuinely available; that any command was actually executed or that transcript files exist at their referenced paths; that verification was genuinely independent of the executor; that secrets are absent from any field (secret detection is a semantic check, not a structural one); that digests match their referenced artefacts; or that a recorded approval is a genuine User act. Those are runtime verification obligations of the P17 execution security contract (SEC-P17-01 through SEC-P17-11) and its gates (GATE-P17-2, GATE-P17-3), which are specified but NOT implemented. A document satisfying this schema is STRUCTURALLY VALID ONLY. Satisfying it authorizes no execution, no implementation, and no approval.
$comment: SCOPE BOUNDARY. STRUCTURALLY ENFORCED HERE: required-property presence (including plan minItems and the lifecycle-state conditionals below); enumerated values (status, step status, outcome, verification result, verifier, decided_by_role, state, environment_policy, probe_method); string patterns (task_id, step_id, depends_on, SHA-256 digests); types, array minItems and uniqueItems, integer minimum; additionalProperties:false at every level; and lifecycle-state coherence (PLANNED and AWAITING_USER_APPROVAL carry no execution, verification, or approval; IN_PROGRESS and FAILED require a present execution; VERIFIED requires a present verification whose result is PASS; REJECTED requires a present approval whose state is REJECTED; BLOCKED requires a non-blank blocked_reason; a COMPLETED execution requires ended_at and exit_status). NOT ENFORCED HERE, REQUIRING THE P17 RUNTIME GATE: probe authenticity, execution authenticity, transcript existence and digest match, verifier independence, secret absence, and approval authenticity. IMPLEMENTED != VERIFIED != APPROVED (sps2/core/SPEC.md).

task_id.description: Unique task identifier, assigned at intake before any work begins (REQ-P17-01).

status.description: Governance-aligned lifecycle state (.sps/GOVERNANCE.md §2). Execution-specific outcomes (COMPLETED, FAILED, TIMEOUT, KILLED) live in execution.outcome; verification outcomes (PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED) live in verification.result. Status never collapses the three axes: IMPLEMENTED != VERIFIED != APPROVED.

goal.description: The task goal as accepted at intake.

required_capabilities.description: Agent capabilities the task requires; deterministic selection (REQ-P17-04) matches these against the discovery snapshot.

plan.description: Ordered plan of steps (REQ-P17-02). Execution does not begin until the plan is approved.

agent_selection.description: Runtime discovery snapshot and deterministic selection with recorded rationale (REQ-P17-03, REQ-P17-04).

execution.description: Controlled local execution record (REQ-P17-05, REQ-P17-06). Absent or null until execution has begun. Its presence is never, by itself, evidence of success.

verification.description: Independent objective verification record (REQ-P17-08). An agent exit code of 0 is not proof of passing; acceptance is judged here.

approval.description: Explicit User approval of the plan or task (GATE-P17-2, GATE-P17-3). Approval is an explicit act by the User, never an agent assertion.

blocked_reason.description: Required, non-blank, when status is BLOCKED; otherwise optional or null.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of task record creation.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent state transition.

digests.description: SHA-256 integrity digests of the plan and of execution transcripts (SEC-P17-11). Never secrets.

allOf.$comment: PLANNED and AWAITING_USER_APPROVAL are pre-execution states: no execution, no verification, and no approval may be recorded yet. Each property may be absent or explicitly null; the properties keyword constrains only present properties, so an absent property is vacuously allowed and a present non-null object is rejected.
IN_PROGRESS requires a present, non-null execution record.
FAILED requires a present, non-null execution record (the failure being recorded).
BLOCKED requires a present, non-blank blocked_reason.
VERIFIED requires a present verification whose result is PASS. A FAIL or BLOCKED verification can never coexist with VERIFIED status.
REJECTED requires a present approval whose state is REJECTED.
A COMPLETED execution requires ended_at and a recorded exit_status.

step_id.description: Ordered step identifier, unique within the plan.

description.description: What this step does. Human-readable and persisted to project-local state.

required_capabilities.description: Agent capabilities this step requires; feeds deterministic selection.

agent_id.description: Agent assigned to this step, or null when the task's selected agent runs it.

status.description: Step-level status within the ordered plan.

depends_on.description: Step identifiers this step depends on; defines the ordering.

output_summary.description: Non-secret summary of the step's output, or null.

discovered_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the runtime discovery probe (REQ-P17-03).

available_agents.description: The discovery snapshot: one entry per allowlisted agent, whether or not it was available. Availability is probed at runtime, never assumed from documentation.

selected_agent.description: The deterministically selected agent, or null when selection has not occurred or failed.

selection_rationale.description: Why the selected agent was chosen and why the alternatives were not (REQ-P17-04).

selection_fingerprint.description: Deterministic fingerprint of the selection inputs; the same requirement and snapshot always yield the same fingerprint.

selected_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of selection, or null.

agent_id.description: Agent identifier as named in the authorized allowlist.

available.description: Runtime probe result. False means the agent was probed and found unavailable - never assumed.

version.description: Version reported by the probe, or null when unavailable.

probe_method.description: How availability was determined at runtime.

agent_id.description: The allowlisted agent that was executed.

command.description: The exact argument vector executed. An argv array, never a shell string, so no shell interpretation is implied.

timeout_seconds.description: The bounded timeout applied to this execution (SEC-P17-04).

working_directory.description: The confined working directory. Confinement is enforced by a tested mechanism, not by this setting alone (SEC-P17-05).

ended_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of execution end; required when outcome is COMPLETED.

outcome.description: Execution outcome. TIMEOUT and KILLED are explicit auditable outcomes, never silent successes.

exit_status.description: Verbatim exit status of the agent process; required when outcome is COMPLETED. A non-zero status is an explicit outcome, never silently treated as success.

stdout_ref.description: Path to the captured stdout transcript, digested in digests.stdout_sha256.

stderr_ref.description: Path to the captured stderr transcript, digested in digests.stderr_sha256.

environment_policy.description: How the execution environment was constructed (SEC-P17-06): minimal inheritance or an explicit allowlist of environment entries. Secrets are never passed through by default.

verifier.description: What performed acceptance verification. Whether an INDEPENDENT_AGENT may verify HIGH/CRITICAL work is UQ-P17-02 (OPEN).

acceptance_command.description: The objective acceptance command(s) that judged the task. An agent exit code of 0 is not acceptance.

result.description: Verification result. FAIL or BLOCKED here forces a non-VERIFIED task status even when the agent exited 0.

independence_statement.description: Why this verification is independent of the executing agent (REQ-P17-08).

evidence_ref.description: Reference to the verification evidence record (.sps/GOVERNANCE.md §4).

decided_by.description: Name of the decider. Approval is an explicit act by the User, never an agent assertion; authenticity is a runtime obligation.

decided_by_role.description: Only the User may approve a plan or task.

basis.description: Why the plan or task was approved or rejected.

state.description: APPROVED permits the gated action; REJECTED drives task status REJECTED.

plan_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the serialized ordered plan.

stdout_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the stdout transcript, or null when no transcript exists.

stderr_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the stderr transcript, or null when no transcript exists.

evidence_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the verification evidence artefact, or null when none exists.
